source.title: Falling Into Place
source.description:
Here is the emblem. I warn you, do not touch it with your bare hand. It exudes a foul necromantic aura that could cause great harm.

I wish you the best in this endeavor, <name>. I will dare hope for your success, but I will prepare for a less favorable outcome.
source.objective:
Combine the Reforged Blade of the Ashbringer, the Emblem of the Ashbringer, and the Hilt of the Ashbringer, and then speak with the Will of the Ashbringer to determine your next steps.

Provided item:
source.completion:
The pieces are falling into place. The weapon is completely inert now, but there's one final step needed to restore the blade's lost power. This next part won't require strength of arms, but it may still prove difficult.

Tell me, <class>,  what do you know of Nordrassil, the World Tree?
